scope: Local Quick Settings track-list follow-up after 4.1.0; not a release or complete visual acceptance

reference.facts: The same source TrackSelector owns each track kind, observes player track/selection changes, uses a 98-point scroll card and 26-point rows, and displays a separate active indicator and intrinsic language badge. Selection submits to the player; observations supply active state.
reference.keyboard_scope: Original Windows keyboard equivalent; exact AppKit arrow/deselection interaction is not established by these captures. No implementation code or assets copied.
reference.comparison: Pinned reference surfaces inspected for hierarchy and control geometry; no matched media/scale pixel score claimed.

implementation: One shared track-list component replaces separate Audio, Video and subtitle implementations.
The list owns one keyboard cursor; backend observations retain exclusive ownership of active selection.
One Tab stop per list; Up/Down/Home/End/Page Up/Page Down reveal the current row; Return/Space apply it.
Empty and disabled lists cannot select; shorter models clamp the cursor; model replacement retains keyboard focus.
Language badges size to text with a 45 percent card cap, reserve track-name space and are now present on Video rows too.

workspace.note: Four child helper executions are exercised by their parent and not counted again.

native_library_source: Verified engine from the 4.1.0 portable package; no native engine rebuild.

manual_gui.fixture_origin: Disposable remux of original CC0 track-languages.mkv; duplicate original MJPEG/PCM packets provide five video and five audio tracks alongside seven existing subtitle tracks. No downloaded media; only this media file is in its folder.
manual_gui.state: Paused on original frame 000; null audio; playlist neighboring-file discovery disabled.
checks: Audio: Original tone to take 1 to take 2 with repeated Down; End to take 4, Page Up to take 1; volume remained 100.
Audio: Tab goes directly to Load External Audio; Shift+Tab returns to the active row without changing it.
Video: original video to take 1 to take 2 with repeated Down; focus and the active indicator advance and scroll.
Primary subtitles: English to German to French with repeated Down and visible rendered cues.
Secondary subtitles: English, Down to German, End to Unknown, Home to None; primary French remained selected and visible.
Native tree exposes named lists and selectable options. Exact invocation bounds/Narrator behavior are not certified.
Dark normal-sized panels and light Audio inspected; Portuguese, Portuguese (Brazil) and Chinese (Traditional) badges visible at normal width.
Native Video > Normal Size produces a 285 x 160 client; light Audio End reaches take 4 with a readable Portuguese badge and an elided track name.
input_limitations: An element-index click aimed at an Audio option landed on an equalizer fader; subsequent track checks used visible screenshot coordinates. This does not establish whether the cause is automation mapping or native accessibility bounds.
Ctrl+1 did not resize while Quick Settings owned focus; the native Normal Size menu action worked. Modified native-menu shortcuts from panel focus remain a follow-up.

desktop_capture.inspection: Full images inspected privately. Fullscreen shows the moving video and controller together; before/after show no persistent Riina surface. Raw captures containing unrelated private content are not published.

remaining_gaps: Matched AppKit keyboard and pixel comparison, middle truncation, platform materials, other DPI and application-port runtime.
Remaining page focus graph, modified native window-size shortcuts from panel focus, and full native accessibility action-bounds/Narrator verification.
Light equalizer thumb contrast and user-preset workflows remain separate Quick Settings work.
Default-ignored native/clipboard tests, audible output and physical HDR were not rerun or certified by this UI batch.
